title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-030
doc_notes: This document contains FAA incident reports, interview transcripts, and press releases regarding an unidentified radar target observed by an Alaska Airlines flight crew in 1987.

incidents.summary: Alaska Airlines Flight 53 crew reported an unidentified target on their onboard weather radar while en route from Nome to Anchorage.
behavior: moved at high rate of speed
incidents.quote: he was there and then he was gone
